newsitem.title: USA: PP&L says it restores power after storm.
newsitem.headline: PP&L says it restores power after storm.

text.p: PP&L Resources Inc said on Tuesday that its Pennsylvania Power & Light unit has restored electric service to more than 114,000 customers after thunderstorms crashed through eastern Pennsylvania on August 16.
The company said the high winds and lightning strikes had damaged 1,100 individual locations in the company's 10,000-square-mile service area.
Since the storms affected a large region, most neighboring utilities, except for Niagara Mohawk Power Corp, were unable to provide much assistance, PP&L said in a statement.
